profile.headline: Inventing the future of holographic experiences
profile.summary:
XR Software Engineer inventing the future of holographic experiences at Rivet. Certified by Adobe and Unity with over ten years of professional XR experience. If you can dream it, I can build it.

Feel free to visit my website at http://www.FiscusMedia.com

positions.title: Lead XR Prototyping Engineer
positions.description:
● Led a team of prototyping software engineers in developing next-generation interactive experiences for HTC VIVE’s XR platforms, transforming conceptual ideas into functional, in-headset prototypes. 
● Directed technical architecture and decision-making, ensuring scalable software solutions and establishing technical standards for future XR development. 
● Pioneered multi-modal prompt engineering using OpenAI (text, audio, images) and Blockade Labs (Skybox AI), leveraging Comfy UI and Stable Diffusion for immersive generative AI prototyping. 
● Mentored engineers in implementing advanced interaction models, enhancing immersive user experiences. 
● Collaborated cross-functionally with designers, researchers, planners, and program managers to define and iterate on high-impact XR concepts. 
● Championed rapid prototyping practices, bridging creative vision with technical feasibility, and enabling iterative exploration of emerging XR technologies.

positions.title: Product Design Prototyper
positions.description:
● Shipped an AI assistant on Portal and Oculus, leveraging prompt engineering with Wit.ai to enhance user interactions. 
● Designed, prototyped, and user-tested cutting-edge AR/VR experiences across multiple Meta product lines, shaping the future of immersive interaction. 
● Explored and defined new modes of spatial interaction by rapidly iterating on experimental concepts. 
● Collaborated closely with cross-functional teams—including engineers, researchers, and product 
managers—to validate ideas through hands-on prototyping and usability testing. 
● Contributed to foundational design patterns and interaction models for next-generation AR/VR platforms.

positions.title: Technical Designer
positions.description:
● Shipped mission-critical features for Remote Assist, an app utilized by NASA astronauts on the ISS during Operation Sidekick. 
● Prototyped and delivered features for high impact customers like NASA JPL, including joystick controls for operating the Mars rover in a virtual environment. 
● Designed and implemented experimental features such as hand menus, body-locked UIs, and 3D responsive interfaces using digital twin data and Azure Spatial Anchors. 
● Developed contextual, in-situ data visualizations leveraging surface magnetism and spatial awareness to enhance mixed reality user interactions. 
● Explored and refined advanced interaction paradigms, ensuring alignment with real-world spatial logic and intuitive user behavior.

positions.title: Senior Prototyper @ Fluent Design Team
positions.description:
● Shipped and implemented the projected drop shadow system for Windows 10, creating the drop shadows visible on every Windows computer globally. 
● Crafted cohesive Fluent Design System experiences across Desktop, Xbox, and Mixed Reality platforms, 
ensuring visual and interaction consistency. 
● Innovated and prototyped new design tools and features for the Windows OS, enhancing user experience with scalable, system-wide UI components. 
● Collaborated closely with design and engineering teams to translate visual concepts into functional, 
high-fidelity prototypes. 
● Delivered high-impact prototypes to support feature validation, usability testing, and executive review, 
accelerating design approval and adoption.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer @ Xbox
positions.description:
● Shipped the "New Xbox One Experience (NXOE)," a major interface overhaul for Xbox One, downloaded 1,000 times per second for 24 hours post-launch. 
● Developed advanced dashboard concepts for Xbox consoles using XAML and C#, contributing to the feature vision for Xbox Scorpio. 
● Produced high-impact concept videos and interactive prototypes to visualize and communicate new user experiences to stakeholders. 
● Explored early-stage Xbox VR features using 2.5D XAML and Windows Composition, pushing the boundaries of console interface design in immersive environments.

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed an intelligent treadmill system integrating Kinect body tracking, heart rate monitoring, and 
adaptive workout logic to deliver personalized fitness experiences. 
● Developed UX flows and interaction models that responded dynamically to user performance and biometric feedback. 
● Collaborated with hardware and software teams to prototype real-time motion tracking and responsive UI elements.
